reasons: Classification is correct: Arizona law is outside the accepted set (NY/DE/CA/England & Wales), so the clause fails both preferred and fallback on a material term — a genuine deviation, not an acceptable fallback.

Redline reaches the preferred position with a targeted edit: only the jurisdiction words are replaced in p0043 and an exclusive New York County venue is added; the severability language and conflict-of-laws carve-out are preserved.

The p0056 edit is proportionate and consistent with the rule's forum concern — it seats the existing arbitration in New York County without disturbing the rules or confirmation mechanics, and correctly does not attempt to delete arbitration (domestic seat, so not walk-away).
Comment is accurate, concise, states what changed and why, cites the playbook position and offers the Delaware/California/England-and-Wales fallbacks without lecturing.
Changed-character ratio of 0.509 in p0043 is explained by the necessary substitution plus the added venue clause; substance remains the smallest edit reaching the playbook position.
